item: A baseline git can merge: duplicates take the larger count, init writes merge=union
notes: docs/proposals/agents-in-consumer-repos.md, section 2: bro format rewrites stylebro.baseline (kept findings added, stale entries removed), so parallel pull requests edit the same file. Duplicate lines add their counts today (Baseline.Parse), so a union merge would allow one violation too many; with the larger count, init and baseline can add 'stylebro.baseline merge=union' to .gitattributes. Done: Baseline.Parse takes the larger count; bro format and bro baseline add the line to the .gitattributes at the git root whenever they write a baseline in a repository, unless a line there already names stylebro.baseline (owner's choice 2026-11-08: on every baseline write); docs/baseline.md, 'Merging branches'.
